Question: Ni iyihe fumbire nakoresha mu bigori?
ResponseJSON: {"answer_id":4,"status":"answered","answer":"Ifumbire zikunze gukoreshwa igihe cyo gutera ibigori ni DAP (18 - 46 - 0) ivanzena ire (46 - 0 - 0), NPK (17 - 17 - 17) na CEREALS (23 - 10 - 5 + 2Mg + 3S + 0. 3Zn). Iyo uhisemo gukoresha DAP ivanze na ire, uvanga biro 100 bya DAP na n\u0027ibiro 50 bya ire, ugatera iyo mvange kuri hegitari imwe cyangwa ukavanga ikilo 1 ya DAP na n\u0027ibiro zeru n\u0027ibice bitanu bya ire ugatera iyo mvange kuri ari imwe. Bityo ukaba ukoresheje ibiro 41 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa azote (nitrogen) na n\u0027ibilo 46 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa fosifore (phosphorus) kuri hegitari. Iyo uhisemo gukoresha NPK (17 - 17 - 17), utera kg 250 kuri hegitari imwe cyangwa kg 2, 5 kuri ari imwe. Bityo ukaba ukoresheje kg 42, 5 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa azote, kg 42, 5 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa fosifore na kg 42, 5 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa potasiyumu (potasium). Iyo uhisemo gukoresha CEREALS (23 - 10 - 5 + 2Mg + 3S + 0. 3Zn), utera kg 200 kuri hegitari. Bityo, ukaba ukoresheje kg 46 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa azote, kg 20 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa fosifore na kg 10 by\u0027umunyu ngugu wa potasiyumu.
